Home.name: Andrei Prado
Home.subtitle: Node.js · React · TypeScript · GCP · GenAI
Home.body: I design and build scalable digital products — from backend APIs to cloud infrastructure, from frontend interfaces to AI-powered workflows. I lead development teams, define technical architecture and deliver end-to-end solutions.

About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: Engineering background, product mindset.
About.paragraph1: I am a Tech Lead and Full Stack Software Engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil, with over 10 years of experience building web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure and AI-powered products.
About.paragraph2: My career has spanned frontend engineering, backend development, cloud architecture and technical leadership. I have worked with companies of different scales — from digital agencies to multinational enterprises — always focused on quality, scalability and delivery.
About.paragraph3: Today I lead the technical scope of a GenAI-powered platform at RD Saúde, where I define architecture, manage cloud infrastructure on GCP, develop backend and frontend features, and support the team through mentoring, code reviews and technical planning.
About.paragraph4: Beyond the stack, I care about engineering culture: writing maintainable code, enabling teams to move fast with confidence, and building things that are actually useful.
About.leadershipSubtitle: Beyond the code — driving teams, architecture and delivery.
highlights: Led up to 4 development squads simultaneously on a streaming platform across Latin America.
Defined and implemented the full technical architecture of a GenAI-powered content platform.
Established code review processes, quality standards and development best practices.
Conducted 1:1s and technical mentoring sessions with developers at different seniority levels.
Aligned technical decisions with product, design and business stakeholders.
Managed CI/CD pipelines, deployment flows and release planning on large-scale projects.
Contributed to architecture decisions that improved platform performance and maintainability.
Onboarded and ramped up new engineers in complex codebases.
